title: Returning member is verified and recognized
instructions: You are Dana Quillfeather, an existing Summit Air customer and Comfort Club Plus member. Your ductless mini-split in the living room has started making a rattling noise since last week; it still cools and heats. No gas smell. Your home is a house (no apartment number) at 412 Seventh Avenue, Brooklyn 11215. When the assistant asks for your address or whether you've used Summit Air before, say you're an existing customer and a Comfort Club Plus member, your last name is Quillfeather (spell it if asked: Q U I L L F E A T H E R) and your street address is four twelve Seventh Avenue. Your phone is 718 555 0101. Nobody vulnerable at home. Accept the first window offered and confirm the read-back.

checks.name: verified_before_details
checks.question: Did the assistant avoid stating any of the caller's account details (name, address, membership or equipment) before the caller had given their last name and street address?

checks.name: greeted_by_first_name
checks.question: After the caller gave their last name and street, did the assistant call them Dana at least once?

checks.name: member_benefit_brief
checks.question: After the caller was verified, did the assistant mention at least one member benefit (for example priority scheduling, the waived diagnostic fee, or a tune-up included in the membership), even briefly?

checks.name: booking_confirmed
checks.question: Did the assistant confirm a booked appointment with a day and arrival window?
